info.name: Livestock ERP - Inventory CRUD
info.description: Inventory CRUD after removing building_zone and rack_bin. Set access_token from the Auth collection and run requests in order on a development database. Requires setup.branches.view and setup.inventories.view/create/update/delete, plus access to the selected branch. The first branch result is captured; use an account with access to it. Only a uniquely named test inventory is created, updated, toggled and soft-deleted. Every request has live response examples and tests. Updates use POST. No obsolete location fields or dropdown endpoint remain.
